description: Look up domain registration details: registrar, creation and expiry dates, status and name servers, plus the full raw WHOIS record.

faqs.a: A public record showing a domain's registrar, registration and expiry dates, status and name servers.
Most registrars now redact personal details for privacy (GDPR). The technical registration data is still shown.
Statuses like clientTransferProhibited describe locks on the domain, for example preventing unauthorized transfers.

howto: Enter the domain you want to look up, e.g. example.com.
Click Look Up to query the WHOIS record.
Read the summary card: registrar, dates, status and name servers.
Scroll the raw output for the complete registration record.
title: Whois Lookup
